learning.objective: Recognise and use numbers 1–10.
learning.instruction: Count each set and match or circle the correct numeral.
learning.expected_response: Use only the page-specific response controls defined below.

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask the child to touch each object once while counting, then choose the numeral.

learning.objective: Count object groups and match each group to its numeral.
learning.instruction: Count each group. Draw a line to the matching number.
learning.expected_response: Four lines connecting quantities 2, 4, 6 and 8 to the matching shuffled numerals.

guidance.teacher_cue: Model counting one group and matching it to a numeral placed on a different row.

teaching_gates: only object groups appear on the left
only numerals appear on the right
no answer line is pre-drawn except the model

learning.objective: Count a group and select the correct numeral.
learning.instruction: Count each group. Circle the correct number.
learning.expected_response: One circled numeral below each of six countable groups.

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask the child to touch each object once before looking at the choices.

learning.objective: Compare two quantities and identify more or less.
learning.instruction: Look at each pair. Circle the group asked for.
learning.expected_response: One selected group in each comparison row.

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask for an estimate first, then verify by counting.

teaching_gates: same object type within each pair

learning.objective: Recognise pairs with the same quantity.
learning.instruction: Count both groups. Circle YES if they are equal. Circle NO if they are not.
learning.expected_response: YES, NO and YES for the three rows.

guidance.teacher_cue: Count the left group, then check whether the right group has the same total.

teaching_gates: one YES and one NO control per row
same object type within each row

learning.objective: Complete forward number sequences with one missing numeral.
learning.instruction: Read each number sequence. Write the missing number.
learning.expected_response: 3, 7 and 14 written in the three blanks.

guidance.teacher_cue: Read forward and pause at the blank without supplying the answer.

learning.objective: Understand addition by combining two groups.
learning.instruction: Count both groups. Add them and circle the total.
learning.expected_response: 3, 5 and 6 selected for the three problems.

guidance.teacher_cue: Sweep both groups together with a finger before counting the total.

teaching_gates: same object type within each problem

learning.objective: Understand subtraction by removing objects from a set.
learning.instruction: Count the set. Cross out the objects taken away. Circle how many remain.
learning.expected_response: 3, 3 and 3 selected after crossing out the specified objects.

asset_meanings.set_5_apples: five apples with the final two spaced apart
asset_meanings.set_4_fish: four fish with the final one spaced apart
asset_meanings.set_6_balloons: six balloons with the final three spaced apart

guidance.teacher_cue: Cross out only the separated end objects, then recount the untouched objects.

teaching_gates: removed objects remain visible under strike marks
subtraction is not represented by cropping

learning.objective: Identify the numeral immediately before and after a given numeral.
learning.instruction: Write the number before and the number after.
learning.expected_response: 3 and 5; 6 and 8; 11 and 13; 17 and 19.

guidance.teacher_cue: Say three numbers around the centre number, leaving the two answers for the child.

learning.objective: Arrange numerals from smallest to greatest.
learning.instruction: Write each set in order from smallest to greatest.

guidance.teacher_cue: Find the smallest numeral first, then count forward.

teaching_gates: tokens and answer slots are separate
token order differs from answer order

learning.objective: Use forward jumps on a number line.
learning.instruction: Start at the marked number. Follow the jumps. Circle where you land.
learning.expected_response: 2, 4 and 5 selected for the three number lines.

guidance.teacher_cue: Point to the start and say one numeral for each arc.

learning.objective: Compare the values of two numerals.
learning.instruction: Circle the greater number in each row.
learning.expected_response: 7, 9, 15, 18, 11 and 20 circled.

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask which numeral comes later in the counting sequence.

learning.objective: Solve simple addition and subtraction picture stories.
learning.instruction: Look at each picture story. Count and circle the answer.
learning.expected_response: 3, 3 and 2 selected for the three stories.

model_text.story: One bird is sitting. One more bird joins.

asset_meanings.story_ducks: two ducks in a pond and one duck joining
asset_meanings.story_balls: one ball on the ground and two more balls arriving
asset_meanings.story_biscuits: three biscuits on a plate with one being taken away by position only

guidance.teacher_cue: Ask what happened first, what changed, and what must be counted now.

teaching_gates: choices are adjacent to the story

learning.objective: Match basic 2D shapes to familiar objects with the same shape.

learning.expected_response: Circle–clock, square–window, triangle–flag and rectangle–door.

guidance.teacher_cue: Trace the shape outline in the air before matching it to an object.

learning.objective: Recognise common 3D objects.
learning.instruction: Match each solid to the object with the same shape.
learning.expected_response: Use only the page-specific response controls defined below.

guidance.teacher_cue: Name each solid, then ask the child to trace its outline in the air before matching.

learning.objective: Find shapes in familiar objects.

guidance.teacher_cue: Name one target at a time. Let the child find and point to it in the playground scene.

learning.objective: Complete repeating patterns.
